title: Assembling Process of Charged Nonanuclear Cationic Lanthanide(III) Clusters Assisted by Dichromium Decacarbonyl Hydride

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: nonanuclear samarium hydroxo acetylacetonate dichromium decacarbonyl hydride salt

material_class.structural_family: square-antiprismatic Ln9 hydroxo-acetylacetonate cluster with [HCr2(CO)10]- counterion

synthesis.procedure: All operations under nitrogen. A solution of Sm(acac)3·3H2O (0.50 g, 1 mmol) in EtOH (30 mL) was slowly added to a stirred yellow solution of K[Cr2(CO)10(μ-H)] (1.27 g, 3 mmol) in EtOH (30 mL) at room temperature. Some yellow crystalline solid soon separated. The stirred mixture was rapidly warmed to 45 °C, stirred at 45–47 °C for 5 h, then at room temperature for 24 h. The yellow crystalline product was collected by filtration, washed with EtOH (3 × 3 mL, until colorless filtrate), and dried under high vacuum. Recrystallized at room temperature from 2:1 v/v CHCl3/toluene.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature addition; 45–47 °C then room temperature
synthesis.time: 5 h at 45–47 °C, then 24 h at room temperature
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, washed with EtOH (3 × 3 mL), dried under high vacuum; recrystallized at room temperature from 2:1 v/v CHCl3/toluene

source_locations.location: no magnetic or optical measurements reported
